title: Development rights given, paid in flats
expect: Supply of services; Rule 27(c) - value of a like kind and quality supply
description: A registered land owner transfers development rights to a builder and receives 10 flats in return. No money is paid. The builder sells similar development rights nearby for Rs 3 crore.
